result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: an invalid discount label and awkward clipping in horizontal carousels.

issues.description: The promotion badge on the lower restaurant card displays “-0%,” which is nonsensical and looks like a pricing or formatting error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when the discount value is zero, or display the correct nonzero discount.

issues.description: Items at the right edge of the category and “Fastest near you” carousels are abruptly cut off, including the restaurant image and name, making the layout look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent trailing viewport padding and use intentional carousel peeking with clean text truncation or ellipses.
